limitations: The chart’s cyclical values are synthetic fixture observations, not a patient or athlete result.

synthetic_rationale: Screenshot is archived in the deterministic ui-inspection workflow, whose documented adapter serves synthetic metrics and trends without a live API.

Current utils/uiInspectionFixtures.ts defines RMSSD unit ms, a deterministic repeating weekly metricValue generator, and metricSeries for /v1/metric_values/search. These establish the synthetic inspection mechanism; the archived screenshot has no historical capture SHA, so the current formula is not asserted to reproduce each August screenshot value exactly.
No participant name, handle, account identifier or personal notes appear in the screen.
